title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-27 10:33:23 最新章节：第一百六十三章 斩将
content_zh:
画眉山，藏龙观。
七星大殿外，周无纪手握拂尘来回踱步，他不时抬头看看头顶深邃星空。
正是深秋时节，北斗七星高悬，斗柄指西。
周无纪想到了前世，那时候他可不会关注星相变化，只会胡扯一些星座骗女人。
现在，他却要天天琢磨北斗星相，试着从中汲取元炁，感应天地变化。
可惜，哪怕他觉醒了宿慧，有着成年人的智力和坚韧，十多年来的进境也只是平平。
这个世界就像古代华夏，不同的是这里有强大修者，有吃人妖魔，有噬魂鬼祟，是一个非常凶险的世界。
想在这个世界活的好，最重要就是有足够力量。
周无纪想到这里禁不住想叹气，他一直在尝试各种方法试图走点捷径。
事实证明，对于修炼来说最重要是天赋，如努力、坚持什么的都是次要的。
小聪明更是没用！
“幸好遇到个好师父，老头本事不错，又有一家道观，跟着老头混吃等死也挺好……”
周无纪正想着好事，就看到大殿内猛然闪过一团强光，跟着就是一声低沉闷响。
他顿时一惊，老头在大殿偷偷做法，怎么搞出这么大动静？
来不及多想，周无纪急忙推门冲进大殿。
北极天帝威严肃穆神像高高在上，神像前的香案摆着香烛、水果、兰花、五谷等祭品。
两盏长明灯散发的昏黄光芒剧烈起伏摇荡，北极天帝神像随之明暗不定，有种难以形容阴沉诡秘。
一个矮胖身影伏在香案前方一动不动，看那身形正是他师父李一元。
周无纪急忙上前想要扶起师父，才靠近就闻到了一股浓烈焦糊味道。
等他把师父扶起来，就看到老头从头至脚是一片焦糊炭黑，看不到一块完好皮肤。

“师父、师父……”周无纪真的惊了，老头样子是大大不妙。
李一元缓缓睁开一只完好眼睛，扩散的瞳孔缓缓收缩，这才看清楚周无纪的脸。
这个轻微动作，却让他脸上崩落几块如碳般细微碎片。
老头认出了最亲近的弟子，心里松了口气。他沙哑着嗓子说道：“无纪、我擅用秘法违了大戒，受到阴雷天罚，我是不成了……”
周无纪虽有两世智慧、经验，眼看师父如此惨状也是心中难过，一时不知该说什么。
老头不但救过他命，还对他最好，哪想到对方会突然遭此横祸！
“时间紧急，你听我说。”
李一元知道自己时间不多了，他要在走之前把后事都交代清楚。
周无纪认真说道：“师父你说、我听着呢！”
“我、”李一元才说一个字，嗓子已经干涩的发不出声音。
周无纪也看出不对，他说道：“师父、你先用灯油在我衣服上写、”
李一元对弟子的机敏反应很满意，但他摇摇头，示意不必如此。
作为七品受箓道士，他自有更精妙法门。
李一元手捏法印凝聚全部精神力量，在周无纪眉心上轻轻点了一下。
“轰”的一声，就像惊雷在周无纪脑子深处炸响，跟着他就“看”到了一本黑色书籍。
书籍形制古朴，黑色封面上有五个玄妙复杂的文字。
content_en:
Huamei Mountain, Hidden Dragon Temple.
Outside the Seven-Star Hall, Zhou Wuji was pacing back and forth with a fly whisk in his hand. He looked up from time to time to look at the deep starry sky above his head.
It is late autumn, the Big Dipper hangs high, and the handle of the dipper points to the west.
Zhou Wuji thought of his past life. At that time, he didn't pay attention to the changes in the astrology and would only lie about some zodiac signs to deceive women.
Now, he has to ponder the Big Dipper stars every day, try to absorb Yuan Qi from them, and sense the changes in the world.
Unfortunately, even if he awakened Su Hui and had the intelligence and tenacity of an adult, his progress in more than ten years was only mediocre.
This world is like ancient China. The difference is that there are powerful cultivators, man-eating monsters, and soul-eating ghosts here. It is a very dangerous world.
If you want to live well in this world, the most important thing is to have enough strength.
Zhou Wuji couldn't help but sigh when he thought of this. He had been trying various methods to take shortcuts.
Facts have proven that the most important thing for cultivation is talent, while hard work and persistence are secondary.
Little cleverness is even more useless!
"Fortunately, I met a good master. The old man is very capable and has a Taoist temple. It would be good to follow the old man and wait until death..."
Zhou Wuji was just thinking about something good when he saw a bright light suddenly flash in the hall, followed by a low muffled sound.
He was suddenly shocked. The old man was doing this secretly in the main hall. How could he make such a big noise?
Without any time to think, Zhou Wuji hurriedly opened the door and rushed into the hall.
The majestic and solemn statue of the Arctic Emperor is high up in the sky. The incense table in front of the statue is filled with incense candles, fruits, orchids, grains and other offerings.
The dim yellow light emitted by the two ever-burning lamps swayed violently, and the statue of the North Pole Heavenly Emperor fluctuated in brightness and darkness, giving it an indescribable gloom and mystery.
A short, fat figure lay motionless in front of the incense table. It turned out that the figure was his master Li Yiyuan.
Zhou Wuji hurriedly stepped forward to help his master up, but as soon as he got closer, he smelled a strong burnt smell.
When he helped the master up, he saw that the old man was completely burnt and black from head to toe, with no intact skin visible.
"Master, Master..." Zhou Wuji was really shocked. The old man looked very bad.
Li Yiyuan slowly opened one intact eye, and his dilated pupil slowly shrank, and then he could see Zhou Wuji's face clearly.
This slight movement caused several carbon-like fragments to fall off his face.
The old man recognized his closest disciple and felt relieved. He said in a hoarse voice: "Wuji, I violated the great precepts by using secret methods, and I was punished by the thunder and heaven. I will never succeed..."
Although Zhou Wuji had the wisdom and experience of two lifetimes, he felt sad when he saw his master in such a miserable state, and he didn't know what to say for a moment.
The old man not only saved his life, but also treated him best. Who would have thought that the other party would suddenly suffer such a misfortune!
"Time is urgent, please listen to me."
Li Yiyuan knew that he didn't have much time, and he had to explain everything clearly before leaving.
Zhou Wuji said seriously: "Master, tell me, I'm listening!"
"I," Li Yiyuan just said one word, and his throat was already too dry to make a sound.
Zhou Wuji also saw something was wrong and said, "Master, first use lamp oil to write on my clothes,"
Li Yiyuan was very satisfied with his disciple's astute response, but he shook his head to indicate that this was not necessary.
As a seventh-grade Taoist priest, he has a more subtle method.
Li Yiyuan squeezed the seal with his hand, gathered all his spiritual power, and tapped Zhou Wuji's eyebrows lightly.
A "boom" sound was like thunder exploding deep in Zhou Wuji's mind, and he "saw" a black book.
The book is simple in shape, with five mysterious and complex words on the black cover.
